title: Ada Tours in the Media: Rankings, Research and Case Studies
description: Coverage of Ada Tours: interviews and reports, Sostav and TenChat rankings, Index Research studies, and GAEO and Workspace case studies. Direct links to original sources.
h1: Ada Tours in the Media: Reports, Rankings and Cases
lead: Interviews with Anna Avanesova, travel-industry reports, comparisons of tour organizers and case studies about Ada Tours. Read our summaries and follow the links to the complete original publications.
leadTitle: Discuss a trip, partnership or media inquiry

sections.heading: First-hand perspectives on Latin America
paragraphsMarkdown: In interviews and professional events, we talk about what our team knows best: planning itineraries across [Brazil](/brazil/), combining [several countries in one journey](/multi-country/) and tailoring trips to individual interests. Our coverage includes Anna's personal experience, work with travel agencies and meetings at international trade shows.
Behind these stories are journeys we design from Rio de Janeiro. Learn more through [our company story](/about/) and [Ada Tours projects](/cases/), then explore the destinations that interest you.

Explore [interviews and reports](#publications), [rankings and practical guides](#ratings), [Index Research studies](#research), [case studies about Ada Tours](#case-publications) and [trade-show directories](#exhibitions).

sections.heading: Anna Avanesova on travel and partnerships
paragraphsMarkdown: [Anna Avanesova](/team/anna-avanesova/) founded Ada Tours and leads the company. She discusses demand for Brazil with international colleagues, shares insights from private travel and introduces Latin America to travel agents.
This collection brings together her comments to travel publications and a separate Price of Business interview. For a closer look at our destinations, explore [Anna's webinars](/webinars/).

sections.heading: From an inspiring article to your own itinerary
paragraphsMarkdown: If an interview inspired you to explore Latin America, tell us what caught your attention: Brazil's natural beauty, a multi-country journey or an itinerary focused on accommodation and service. We'll discuss dates and preferences, then look at [our tours](/tours/) and [VIP journeys](/vip/) as starting points.
We create tailored proposals for [travel agents and tour operators](/dmc/travel-agencies/). For meetings, exhibitions or corporate groups, see our [business travel services](/mice/).

faqHeading: Frequently asked questions about Ada Tours publications

faq.question: What types of travel does Ada Tours discuss in the media?
faq.answerMarkdown: Journeys through [Brazil](/brazil/) and Latin America, private travel, [VIP itineraries](/vip/), cooperation with travel agents and [business travel](/mice/). The collection also includes international partnership news and travel-trade exhibition reports.

faq.question: Who represents Ada Tours in interviews and at events?
faq.answerMarkdown: [Anna Avanesova](/team/anna-avanesova/), founder and CEO of Ada Tours, frequently speaks on behalf of the company in these reports. Photo features also show other members of our team.

faq.question: Which rankings, research and case studies are included?
faq.answerMarkdown: You'll find independent authored comparisons on Sostav, TenChat and DTF, Index Research studies and GAEO and Workspace case studies. Materials produced as part of Ada Tours' promotion through GAEO are separated from interviews and industry reports. Each comparison uses its own criteria; methods and conditions are available in the linked publication.

faq.question: Where can I read the complete original publication?
faq.answerMarkdown: Follow the link beneath each summary to the original publisher or organizer. Sources are available in Russian, English and Portuguese. Each Index Research study also links directly to its public GitHub repository under “README and data on GitHub,” with its methodology and supporting materials.

faq.question: How do I request an interview or comment from Ada Tours?
faq.answerMarkdown: Use the form on this page or our [contact details](/contacts/). Include your publication, topic, format and deadline. For travel or event inquiries, please also share the destination and dates.
